daemon_mode.description: Run as background daemon (true) or exit after one update (false).

pidfile_path.description: Path where inadyn writes its process ID when running as daemon.

update_period.description: How often (in seconds) to check for IP address changes. Must be ≥ 60.

log_file.description: Path to log file. Use '-' to log to standard error (or use systemd logging).

providers.description: List of dynamic DNS providers to monitor. Add at least one provider to enable updates.

name.description: Unique section name for this provider (e.g., 'dyndns', 'cloudflare'). Must match one of the known providers (see inadyn -v).

username.description: Username, email, or API token (as required by the provider).

password.description: Password or app-specific token for authentication.

hostnames.description: List of hostnames (FQDNs) to update. Commas allowed in input, but stored as array.

server_url.description: Override the default DDNS update endpoint URL (e.g., for self-hosted DDNS servers).

ip_url.description: Custom URL to fetch public IP (e.g., 'https://ifconfig.me/ip'). If omitted, uses built-in detection.

ip_version.description: Force IPv4 or IPv6 updates. If omitted, defaults to detected address family.

timeout.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds. Range: 5–300.
